findings.passage: In a turbulent time where voting and constitutional rights are being threatened, I will work to ensure that both are kept intact for all of the constituents in District 12.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, section 'Democracy & Freedom'. General statement on protecting voting rights. It does not mention ID, citizenship proof, or any specific law. Date is the site publication date shown in the page code (Oct 20, 2026), not the date the words were written.
